messages.text: All four Chromium journeys now pass on desktop and mobile, including server-filtered catalog results, detail navigation, persisted cart contents, checkout, public API filtering, and analytics. I’m doing the final production build and visual inspection of the fresh storefront/analytics captures, then I’ll leave the verified dev server available on the documented local URL; the only acceptable finish is clean build output plus visually intact responsive surfaces.
